references.text: Lot shows corresponding hospitality by offering foot washing to his guests
Feet are washed as part of hospitality, just as in Abraham's case
Joseph's steward provides water for foot washing as a gesture of hospitality
The old man in Gibeah shows hospitality, including foot washing
David urges Uriah to wash his feet, a reference to the custom of hospitality
Abigail offers to wash her master's servants' feet as a gesture of humility and service
Jesus points out the lack of foot washing as an neglect of the custom of hospitality
Jesus washes the disciples' feet as an example of service and humility
Foot washing is mentioned as a good deed linked to hospitality
Abraham's concrete act of hospitality in Genesis illustrates and anchors the theological principle of 'pursuing hospitality' in Romans.
